ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=47b7d39a4628 (2026-05-13T10:59:26Z) bumped npm production dependencies in the frontend service, which introduced large unoptimized transitive dependencies — specifically moment.js (~512KB), @tremor/react (~380KB), and recharts (~290KB) — causing the webpack-compiled main.js bundle to grow from ~1.6MB to ~4.8MB (raw). On mobile connections (3G/4G), this ~3.2MB increase in blocking JS causes render-blocking download times of 4–6 seconds, pushing LCP p75 from ~1820ms to ~9100ms, breaching the 2500ms SLO. Desktop clients on faster connections are unaffected. The CI bundle size gate was advisory-only and did not block the deploy.
ground_truth_remediation: Immediately roll back the frontend service to the previous build sha=52a8a76cf862 to restore the smaller bundle and bring mobile LCP p75 back within SLO (<2500ms). After rollback, re-introduce the npm dependency bumps selectively with tree-shaking enforced for moment.js (replace with date-fns or use moment/min/moment.min.js), add hard bundle size budget enforcement in webpack.config.js and CI (fail build if main.js exceeds 1.5MB), and enable code-splitting for @tremor/react and recharts via dynamic import() before re-deploying.
